text: The design shall place the battery, the toggle switch, the DC jack and the hinge pin from the parts catalogue, without the parts colliding, with the battery lying along the box's long axis, the jack facing one short end and the switch on the lid's top face, and shall declare that layout.

The 26.5 x 17.5 x 48.5 mm battery shall sit in a pocket with at least 0.2 mm clearance to every printed surface apart from where it rests on its floor (and no more than 0.5 mm of gap on each of its two long sides and its top), and its snap-clip zone at the terminal end shall lie inside the closed box.

With the lid closed, the battery shall be held so it can move at most 1.0 mm in total across its width and thickness, and along its length no more than its clip zone plus 1.5 mm, with a printed stop at the end opposite the terminals.

The toggle switch shall go through a hole in the lid plate (2 to 4 mm thick, the hole 0.2 to 0.8 mm bigger than the bushing), seated against the plate's underside, with its mounting nut and its lever swing free of every printed surface and its body and solder lugs clear of the box.

With the lid closed, a 5.5 x 2.1 mm DC plug with an 11 mm dia handle shall plug fully into the jack through a single opening in the end wall without touching the box, the opening shall be no more than 1.5 mm bigger than the plug on any side, and the jack shall be held in place.

The lid shall be hinged on a 3 mm steel dowel pin, 24 mm long, held captive in the hinge bores (a press fit in one part, a clearance fit in the other), and the lid shall swing open to 100 degrees without any part of the lid or the switch hitting the base, the battery or the jack.

The lid shall be held closed by a snap latch on the side opposite the hinge (a cantilever hook, free length at least 8 mm, 1.2 to 2.5 mm thick, 0.4 to 1.2 mm of catch overlap, strain at most 2 percent), as a flat plate with a locating lip that does not fuse to the base and leaves a seam of at most 0.5 mm.
The closed box shall have no openings other than the switch hole, the jack opening, the hinge bores and the seam, and its walls, floor and lid plate shall be 2 to 4 mm thick.
The base and the lid shall each be one manifold body that prints on an FDM printer without supports.
The closed box shall be no larger than 90 x 45 x 30 mm, not counting the switch lever, and shall stand flat on a desk without tipping.
With the lid swung open, the battery, with its snap clip, shall drop straight into the pocket and lift straight out without touching the lid, the switch, the jack or the base.
The design shall be delivered as a base STL, a lid STL, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own clearance report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.
